title: Re4: Scientific Computing Agent with Rewriting, Resolution, Review and Revision
abstract: arXiv:2508.20729v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated abilities to perform complex tasks in multiple domains, including mathematical and scientific reasoning. In this work, we construct a novel agent framework for solving representative problems in scientific computing. The proposed agent incorporates a "rewriting-resolution-review-revision" logical chain via three reasoning LLMs (the Consultant, Reviewer, and Programmer) in a collaborative and interactive manner. The Consultant module enables knowledge transfer to link problems to professional domain insights, thereby rewriting problem descriptions through text augmentation. The Programmer module generates and executes well-structured code to solve problems. The Reviewer module enables self-debugging and self-refinement through interactive feedback with code runtime outputs. translated_title: Re4：具备重写、解析、审查与修订功能的科学计算智能体
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）已经展示了在多个领域执行复杂任务的能力，包括数学和科学推理。在这项工作中，我们构建了一个新颖的智能体框架，用于解决科学计算中的代表性问题。所提出的智能体通过三个推理大语言模型（顾问、审查员和程序员）以协作和交互的方式，融入了“重写-解析-审查-修订”的逻辑链。顾问模块实现知识迁移，将问题与专业领域洞察联系起来，从而通过文本增强重写问题描述。程序员模块生成并执行结构良好的代码来解决问题。审查员模块通过与代码运行输出的交互式反馈实现自我调试和自我完善。通过端到端的审查机制，程序员的可执行代码经历迭代修订。
tldr: 该论文提出Re4科学计算智能体框架，通过顾问、审查员和程序员三个大语言模型的协作交互，构建“重写-解析-审查-修订”逻辑链，实现代码的迭代生成、调试与完善，以解决科学计算问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Re4, a scientific computing agent framework that incorporates a "rewriting-resolution-review-revision" logical chain through three collaborative LLMs (Consultant, Reviewer, and Programmer) to iteratively generate, debug, and refine executable code for solving scientific computing problems.
